scope: Bounded 35.7-P producer proposal assessment only; final follow-up limited to consequential findings and their corrections

resolved_findings.issue: A rejected later retry was not sufficient terminal proof for an already-unknown operation. An original held before authorization could commit after revoke, denied retry, and subsequent role restoration; a replacement ID could duplicate a create.
resolved_findings.resolution: Retain captured identity, unconfirmed state and replacement/navigation guard after later per-call rejection. Added explicit delayed-original/revoke/denied-retry/restore/same-ID race with one target and one audit. Verified proposal.md lines 33,49,102,109 and matching JSON retry/assertion/approval fields.

resolved_findings.issue: Fresh already-approved no-op success and receipt changed existing deliberate reapproval/audit semantics while being described alongside preserved policy.
resolved_findings.resolution: No-op removed. Fresh approval of an already-approved revision is an explicit proposed owner-approved tightening, with rejection/refresh and no receipt/audit. Existing distinct reapproval behavior is acknowledged; exact committed replay remains historical. Verified proposal.md lines 61,105,121 and matching JSON approval/test/approval-text fields.
